why: What `init` writes into a consumer's repo freezes at 3.0, and four parts of it are traps. `sync` never refreshes `.basalt/hook.mjs`, the hook entries in .claude/settings.json or the committed token sheets, so whatever ships in 3.0.0 stays in every install, and `doctor` tells the user to run `sync` for it. The pre-edit guard blocks every edit under `.basalt/` while the shipped rules tell the agent to edit `.basalt/manifest.json` (`bespoke`, `tokens`, `profile`). `budget.json` starts at `waivers: 0`, so the first reasoned waiver fails `lint`, has no format field and drops unknown keys. The CLI runs under Bun only (shebang, `Bun.spawnSync`, `Bun.serve`) while `init` installs with npm, pnpm or yarn, so a user without Bun gets every Edit blocked by the hook. Also: eject ships with no experimental marker, `doctor --from` is documented and does nothing, `migrate` is missing from help, two waiver counters disagree, fix-its hard-code `bun add`, and dead 2.x managed-files code feeds the tarball-parity check. Evidence: docs/v3/evidence/readiness-2026-11-24/guards.md, docs/v3/evidence/readiness-2026-11-24/agent.md (P1 row 2), docs/v3/evidence/readiness-2026-11-24/freeze.md rows 9 and 10. Trial 2 (docs/v3/evidence/readiness-2026-11-24/trial-2.md, entries 7, 8 and 25): `init` ends by telling the agent to continue in a new session, which an unattended agent cannot do; the rules and the hook reached the same session anyway, the skills and the reviewer agent did not.
what: Every file `init` writes is versioned, refreshed by `sync`, checked by `doctor`, and the CLI runs under Node.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/** (init, sync, doctor, lint, budget, eject, help), bin/basalt-ui.mjs, agent/templates/hook.mjs.tpl
the lines in agent/rules and agent/skills/basalt-app that name a CLI flag this row changes
must_not_touch: the lint rules themselves and their ids (ga-names)
the site profile steps (ga-site-path, which lands after this row)
change:
Read first: docs/v3/issues/ga/README.md, then the evidence file named in why (every finding there has path:line). Decided: (1) The bin runs under Node 22 or newer: `node` shebang, no `Bun.*` on any path (`shot` serves with node:http), `engines.node` declared; Bun keeps working. (2) `sync` owns the hook shim, the hook entries in .claude/settings.json (merged, never clobbering the user's other entries) and every token sheet recorded in the manifest; `doctor`'s messages name a command that fixes what they report. (3) The pre-edit guard splits manifest keys: `managed`, `ejected`, `version`, `sibling` are CLI-owned and refused; `bespoke`, `tokens`, `profile` are the consumer's and pass. The hook fails closed only for paths under the declared roots, `.basalt/` and `.claude/`. (4) Budget: in an app the waiver ceiling follows the count and the base-ref ratchet reports growth in the diff; `--consumer` stays a rule of this repo only; the file gets `"format": 1` and keeps unknown keys. manifest.json gets the same format field if it lacks one, and `sync` migrates an older format. (5) One waiver counter (`countSource`) for `doctor` and `lint --stats`; the `eslint-disable` spelling is counted. (6) Eject is marked experimental in help, docs and MAINTAINING: its on-disk format may change in a minor. Fix the two stale sentences in its help. (7) `doctor --from` is removed; the skill points at `migrate --from --profile

`; `migrate` is in `--help`. (8) Fix-it messages build the install command from the detected package manager. (9) The dead 2.x managed-files code is deleted and tarball parity is computed from what `sync` renders plus the hook template. (10) `doctor`'s profile map covers charts, cards, table and page. What the code decides: the settings merge and the format migration shape. (11) The closing note of `init` and `sync` states what is live in the running session (path-scoped rules, the hook) and what is not (skills, the reviewer agent), and gives the path for an agent that cannot restart: read the named `SKILL.md` files, run `basalt-ui lint --changed` after edits, and run the reviewer by handing its file to a general agent. No "stop here" wording.
acceptance: The CLI test suite runs under Node in CI (a job with no Bun on PATH runs `init`, `sync`, `doctor`, `lint` on a fixture)
A fixture install with an old hook shim and a stale token sheet is whole after `sync`, and `doctor` is green
The hook lets an agent add a `bespoke` directory to the manifest and refuses an edit of `managed` (tests)
A first reasoned waiver in an app fixture passes `lint`; an unreasoned one fails
`basalt-ui --help` lists every verb the dispatcher accepts (test)
out_of_scope: New CLI verbs. The oxlint plugin API risk (ga-peers declares the peer).
proof: The Node-only CI job and the sync-heals-an-old-install test.
commits: Conventional, empty scope, header at most 80 characters, packages/basalt-ui/** in its own commits. Never feat!: and no BREAKING CHANGE footer (docs/release.md). A changed or removed export, prop, rule id or CLI flag gets its row in migrations/areas and MIGRATING.md and regenerates the docs in the same PR.
